title: Lost fishing gear each year vs. the Eiffel Tower (metric tons)

source.name: Abandoned, lost or discarded fishing gear (640,000 t/yr); Eiffel Tower key figures (10,100 t)
source.publisher: FAO/UNEP; Societe d'Exploitation de la Tour Eiffel

notes: 640,000 metric tons of fishing gear are lost or abandoned in the ocean every year (FAO/UNEP); the Eiffel Tower weighs about 10,100 metric tons in total, so that is roughly 63 Eiffel Towers a year.
